name: Cosme
positioning: Beachfront resort of local stone in the village of Naoussa on Paros, officially Cosme, a Luxury Collection Resort, Paros
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base a short walk from Naoussa town
Design lovers drawn to Cycladic architecture and local art

facts.text: Cosme is a beachfront resort in the village of Naoussa on Paros, with the Aegean at its feet.
The center of Naoussa town is about a 10-minute walk along the coast from the hotel.
The architecture is by ID Laboratorium and reflects the shapes of the surroundings.
All buildings are clean-lined and made with local stone, inspired by the island's fishing villages and indigenous houses.
Meandering pathways through the property create an intimate village-style feel.
The suites blend traditional textures and local stone with curated decoration and have terraces shaded by wicker pergolas.
Interiors use warm shades such as olive green, deep burgundy, red and blue alongside traditional Cycladic white.
The hotel's art centers on three themes: naval tradition, folklife and Mediterranean summer.
Cosme has a private Beach Club with seaside loungers, cocktails and snacks.
The Fitness Hall has Technogym equipment and is built with local Parian stone and wood, with natural light through the day.
Greek chef Yiannis Kioroglou leads the dining, having joined from La Petite Maison in Cannes and La Guerite in Saint Barth.
Parostia restaurant sits on the beachfront and takes its name from the stone oven of traditional Parian houses.

highlights.text: The infinity pool is shaped like a half-moon, mirroring the bay of Naoussa.
A stargazing platform at the resort's highest point has 360-degree views of Naoussa, the sea and the mountains of Paros.
The leading artist is Margarita Myrogianni, whose pieces draw on fishermen's nets, sea urchin shapes, nautical ropes and Cycladic light.
The Cosmos Suite terrace has its own private plunge pool, sunbeds and an open-air dining area.
Elios Spa has two treatment rooms and a relaxation area with an indoor jacuzzi.

considerations.text: The hotel has no accessible rooms.
WhataHotel notes seasonal operation, with limited availability outside the summer months.
